categories.main_business_segments: Good Com Asset operates four main business segments: (1) Wholesale, selling newly built investment condominiums under its GENOVIA brand to domestic and overseas corporate clients; (2) Retail Sales, selling the same properties to individual investors; (3) Real Estate Management, providing property and rental management services, including rent guarantee, mainly for properties sold by the company; and (4) Other, which includes consulting for IPOs and IR, small-lot real estate investment products, and real estate fund (asset management) business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in the planning, development, and sale of its proprietary GENOVIA series condominiums, featuring ecological designs such as wall and rooftop greening and pet-friendly amenities. It employs a business model that includes both acquiring entire buildings from developers and developing properties from land acquisition. The company emphasizes efficient procurement (often with only down payments at contract), standardized security features, and after-sales management services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and overseas corporations (for bulk sales), as well as individual investors seeking stable rental income, asset diversification, or inheritance/retirement planning. The main end market is the investment real estate sector, particularly targeting single professionals, DINKS, and elderly singles in metropolitan areas.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in the Tokyo 23 wards and the greater Tokyo metropolitan area (one metropolis and three prefectures), with expansion into other major Japanese regions such as Osaka, Hokkaido, Kyushu, and Okinawa. Overseas activities (previously in Taiwan and China) have been wound down, with current business almost entirely domestic.
categories.supply_chain_position: Good Com Asset operates primarily in the downstream segment of the real estate supply chain, focusing on property development, sales, and post-sale management. It also acts as an asset manager and fund operator in the real estate investment value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sales channels (especially wholesale and real estate funds), increasing recurring revenue from property management, and launching new businesses such as private REITs. The company is also focused on sustainability (eco-friendly building designs, ZEH compliance), risk diversification, and M&A for business diversification. There is no mention of traditional R&D, but innovation is pursued through business model evolution and sustainability initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of newly built investment condominiums (one-off sales), with additional recurring income from property and rental management services, rent guarantees, consulting, and asset management fees from real estate funds. The company also earns fees from small-lot real estate investment products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other Japanese real estate developers and investment property firms focused on the Tokyo metropolitan area. Good Com Asset positions itself as a leading provider of investment condominiums with a strong brand, high occupancy rates, and integrated management services, aiming for top-tier market capitalization among Japanese real estate companies by 2030.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, consolidated sales reached approximately 59.8 billion yen (up 169% YoY), with net profit attributable to shareholders of 3.3 billion yen (up 222% YoY). The company has demonstrated rapid growth, targeting a 30-40% annual average growth rate and aiming for 600 billion yen in sales and 60 billion yen in operating profit by FY2030. The company maintains a healthy balance sheet with a 35.3% equity ratio and 186 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Good Com Asset differentiates itself through its proprietary GENOVIA brand, offering eco-friendly, secure, and conveniently located investment condominiums with standardized high-quality features. The company emphasizes stable rental demand, high occupancy rates, and comprehensive after-sales management, providing both investors and tenants with peace of mind and long-term asset value.
